title: Snake Poison
question: What are the two different ways in which snake poison acts?

meanings.usage: 指能使生物中毒的有害物质
表示投放毒物使中毒的动作
不可数名词，指口腔分泌的消化液
常用于修饰与消化功能相关的器官、液体等
后接名词，表示某事物难以被完成/理解，或公然违抗规则、权威
不可数名词，指被其他动物捕食的生物
可作可数或不可数名词，指非必需的、能带来便利或享受的事物
指以肉类为主要食物的动物，反义词为herbivore（食草动物）
指有脊椎骨的动物，反义词为invertebrate（无脊椎动物）
可指调配物质，也可指编造故事、借口等
不可数名词，指药物、毒物等的作用强度
常与介词of/into搭配，表示从一种形式变为另一种形式的过程
特指生物分泌的有毒液体，区别于普通的poison
用于描述事物发展的初期阶段，相对不够先进
可指化学配方、数学公式，也可指方案、方法

phrases.usage: 表示以某物为食、靠某物生存

examples.en: They could have caught and lived on prey without using poison.
examples.zh: 它们本可以不用毒液，就捕获猎物并以此为生。

examples.en: Most pandas live on bamboo in the wild.
examples.zh: 野外的大多数大熊猫以竹子为食。

phrases.usage: 比喻具有利弊两面性的事物，即双刃剑

examples.en: It would be an assistance to all carnivores though it would be a two-edged weapon when they fought each other.
examples.zh: 这对所有食肉动物都有帮助，不过当它们互相打斗时，这就会是一把双刃剑。

examples.en: Social media is a two-edged weapon: it connects people but also spreads misinformation easily.
examples.zh: 社交媒体是一把双刃剑：它能连接人们，但也很容易传播不实信息。

phrases.usage: 用于形容词或副词比较级、最高级前，强调程度，意为“……得多，显然”

examples.en: Both poisons are unpleasant, but by far the more unpleasant is the blood poison.
examples.zh: 两种毒液都很可怕，但血溶性毒液显然要更伤人。

examples.en: This is by far the best movie I have watched this year.
examples.zh: 这显然是我今年看过的最好的电影。

phrases.usage: 插入语，用于表达比喻、不太严谨的说法，意为“可以说，打个比方”

examples.en: The blood poison is, so to speak, a newer product from an improved formula.
examples.zh: 可以说，血溶性毒液是配方改良后的新产品。

examples.en: In many ways, the Internet is, so to speak, a new global public space.
examples.zh: 从很多方面来说，互联网可以说是一个全新的全球公共空间。

phrases.usage: 让步表达，意为“尽管如此，话虽如此”，用于承认前文观点后转折引出新内容

examples.en: Be that as it may, the nerve poison does its business with man far more quickly than the blood poison.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，神经性毒液作用于人体的速度还是比血溶性毒液快得多。

examples.en: Be that as it may, we still need to consider the potential risks of the plan.
examples.zh: 话虽如此，我们还是需要考虑这个计划的潜在风险。

phrases.usage: 非正式表达，意为“发挥作用，奏效”

examples.en: The nerve poison does its business with man far more quickly than the blood poison.
examples.zh: 神经性毒液对人体产生作用的速度比血溶性毒液快得多。

examples.en: The medicine will do its business in half an hour and you will feel less pain.
examples.zh: 这个药半小时后就会起效，你就不会那么疼了。

sentences.en: How in came about that snakes manufactured poison is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 蛇是怎样产生毒液的，这至今仍是个谜。

sentences.en: Over the periods their saliva, a mild, digestive juice like our own, was converted into a poison that defies analysis even today.
sentences.zh: 经过漫长的岁月，它们的唾液——一种像我们人类唾液一样的温和的消化液——变成了毒液，这种毒液即使在今天也无法分析其成分。

sentences.en: It was not forced upon them by the survival competition;
sentences.zh: 毒液并不是由生存竞争强加给它们的；

sentences.en: they could have caught and lived on prey without using poison, just as the thousands of non-poisonous snakes still do.
sentences.zh: 它们本来可以不用毒液捕食猎物而生存下来，就像成千上万的无毒蛇今天仍然在做的那样。

sentences.en: Poison to a snake is merely a luxury;
sentences.zh: 对蛇来说，毒液只是一种奢侈品；

sentences.en: it enables it to get its food with very little effort, no more effort than one bite.
sentences.zh: 它能使蛇毫不费力地获取食物，一口咬下去便大功告成。

sentences.en: And why only snakes?
sentences.zh: 为什么只有蛇有毒液呢？

sentences.en: Cats, for instance, would be greatly helped;
sentences.zh: 拿猫来说，毒液对它们会大有帮助；

sentences.en: no running fights with large, fierce rats or tussles with grown rabbits--just a bite and no more effort needed.
sentences.zh: 它们不必和凶猛的大老鼠追逐撕打，也不必和长大的兔子扭斗——只需一口咬下去，便不必再费力气了。

sentences.en: In fact, it would be an assistance to all carnivores though it would be a two-edged weapon when they fought each other.
sentences.zh: 事实上，毒液对所有的食肉动物都会有帮助，尽管在它们互相搏斗时，毒液会变成一把双刃剑。

sentences.en: But, of the vertebrates unpredictable Nature selected only snakes (and one lizard).
sentences.zh: 但在脊椎动物中，变幻莫测的大自然只选择了蛇（和一种蜥蜴）。

sentences.en: One wonders also why Nature, with some snakes concocted poison of such extreme potency.
sentences.zh: 人们也想知道，为什么大自然让有些蛇产生如此剧烈的毒液。

sentences.en: In the conversion of saliva into poison, one might suppose that a fixed process took place. It did not;
sentences.zh: 在唾液变为毒液的过程中，人们可能会认为发生了一个固定的过程。但事实并非如此；

sentences.en: some snakes manufactured a poison different in every respect from that of others,
sentences.zh: 有些蛇产生的毒液与另一些蛇的毒液在各个方面都不同，

sentences.en: as different as arsenic is from strychnine, and having different effects.
sentences.zh: 就像砷和士的宁的区别一样大，而且有不同的效果。

sentences.en: One poison acts on the nerves, the other on the blood.
sentences.zh: 一种毒液作用于神经，另一种作用于血液。

sentences.en: The makers of the nerve poison include the mambas and the cobras and their venom is called neurotoxic.
sentences.zh: 产生神经毒液的包括曼巴蛇和眼镜蛇，它们的毒液被称为神经毒素。

sentences.en: Vipers (adders) and rattlesnakes manufacture the blood poison, which is known as haemolytic.
sentences.zh: 蝰蛇（蝮蛇）和响尾蛇产生血液毒液，这种毒液被称为溶血性毒素。

sentences.en: Both poisons are unpleasant, but by far the more unpleasant is the blood poison.
sentences.zh: 两种毒液都不好，但更不好的是血液毒液。

sentences.en: It is said that the nerve poison is the more primitive of the two, that the blood poison is, so to speak, a newer product from an improved formula.
sentences.zh: 据说神经毒液是两种毒液中较原始的一种，而血液毒液，可以说，是改进配方的新产品。

sentences.en: Be that as it may, the nerve poison does its business with man far more quickly than the blood poison.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，神经毒液对人起作用的速度比血液毒液快得多。

sentences.en: This, however, means nothing.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不说明什么。

sentences.en: Snakes did not acquire their poison for use against man but for use against prey such as rats and mice,
sentences.zh: 蛇获得毒液并不是为了对付人，而是为了对付像老鼠之类的小动物，

sentences.en: and the effects on these of viperine poison is almost immediate.
sentences.zh: 蝰蛇毒液对这些猎物几乎能立即见效。

exercises.prompt: “当定语从句的主语与先行词一致，且从句谓语包含be动词时，可以省略关系代词和be动词，保留其余成分” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 先行词 + （关系代词 + be动词） + 分词/形容词/介词短语
options: 条件状语从句 (Adverbial Clause of Condition)
非限制性定语从句 (Non-restrictive Attributive Clause)
exercises.explain: 定语从句的省略形式：先行词 + （关系代词 + be动词） + 分词/形容词/介词短语：用于简化句子结构，使表达更简洁，常见于书面语

那些不喜欢噪音的人有时会使用最不充分的证据

约翰·杜威曾非常严肃地说，习俗在塑造个人行为中所起的作用，

grammar.title: 虚拟语气：could have done
grammar.definition: 表示对过去本可以发生但实际没有发生的事情的假设，译为“本可以做某事（却没做）”
grammar.structure: 主语 + could have + 动词过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于评论过去的行为，表达遗憾、推测或者假设的可能性

examples.en: They could have caught and lived on prey without using poison, just as the thousands of non-poisonous snakes still do.
examples.zh: 它们本可以不用毒液，就捕获猎物并以此为生，就像数千种无毒蛇现在仍然做的那样。

examples.en: You could have passed the exam if you had studied harder last week.
examples.zh: 如果你上周更努力学习的话，你本可以通过考试的。

grammar.title: 定语从句的省略形式
grammar.definition: 当定语从句的主语与先行词一致，且从句谓语包含be动词时，可以省略关系代词和be动词，保留其余成分
grammar.structure: 先行词 + （关系代词 + be动词） + 分词/形容词/介词短语
grammar.usage: 用于简化句子结构，使表达更简洁，常见于书面语

examples.en: Over the periods their saliva, a mild, digestive juice like our own, was converted into a poison that defies analysis even today.
examples.zh: 经过很长的时间，它们的唾液——一种和我们的唾液一样的温和消化液——转变成了一种甚至至今都无法分析清楚的毒液。

examples.en: The book written by my favorite author has sold over 1 million copies.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的作家写的那本书已经卖出了超过100万册。

patterns.pattern: How it came about that... is a mystery.

original.en: How it came about that snakes manufactured poison is a mystery.
original.zh: 蛇是如何产生毒液的，这是个谜。

examples.en: How it came about that this ancient building survived the war is a mystery.
examples.zh: 这座古建筑是如何在战争中幸存下来的，这是个谜。

examples.en: How it came about that he mastered three foreign languages in two years is a mystery to all of us.
examples.zh: 他是如何在两年内掌握三门外语的，对我们所有人来说都是个谜。

original.en: It is said that the nerve poison is the more primitive of the two, that the blood poison is, so to speak, a newer product from an improved formula.
original.zh: 据说在这两种毒液中，神经性毒液是更原始的一种，可以说，血溶性毒液是配方改良后的新产品。

examples.en: It is said that this place used to be a royal garden, that many emperors spent their summers here.
examples.zh: 据说这个地方曾经是皇家园林，很多皇帝都在这里避暑。

examples.en: It is said that drinking warm water in the morning is good for your stomach, that it helps speed up your metabolism.
examples.zh: 据说早上喝温水对胃有好处，还能帮助加快新陈代谢。

patterns.pattern: ...did not acquire... for use against... but for use against...

original.en: Snakes did not acquire their poison for use against man but for use against prey such as rats and mice.
original.zh: 蛇获得毒液不是为了用来对抗人类，而是为了用来对付老鼠之类的猎物。

examples.en: He did not take the course for use against exams but for use against practical problems in his work.
examples.zh: 他学这门课不是为了应付考试，而是为了解决工作中的实际问题。

examples.en: This law was not made for use against ordinary citizens but for use against people who break public order.
examples.zh: 这项法律的制定不是为了约束普通公民，而是为了惩治破坏公共秩序的人。
